english.title: Child minder fail to stop smoking in smoke-free premises at place of residence - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person registered to act as a child minder under Part 2 of the Children and Families (Wales) Measure 2010, failed to take reasonable steps to cause a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), smoking in premises which formed part of premises that were your usual place of residence and were smoke free by virtue of section 9 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), to stop smoking
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(3), (6) and (9) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
